newsitem.title: USA: Apple Computer seen opening cybercafes.
newsitem.headline: Apple Computer seen opening cybercafes.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc plans to work with restaurant operators to open cybercafes in the U.S. and Europe beginning in late 1997, a person close to Apple said.

The third-biggest maker of personal computers will license its name and famous half-eaten apple logo to three restaurant groups, which will open cafes where patrons can browse the Internet, play games and eat.
Apple officials declined to comment, but said the company will be making an announcement later this afternoon.
The first cybercafe will be opened in Los Angeles in late 1997, the person close to Apple said. Restaurants in Paris, New York and London will follow.
Mega Bytes International and Landmark Entertainment Group are expected to be two of the chains involved in the venture. -- Kourosh Karimkhany, in Palo Alto, +1 415 846 5401
